known_safe_checks: TaskLite ships inside the repro-agent repository: its source is under examples/tasklite/app/. Read it there rather than at the repository root.
Run `tasklite where` to print the data directory this install is actually using. TASKLITE_HOME overrides the default, so never assume the default path.
Run `tasklite --version` and compare it against the version the symptom was reported for.
Read the newest file in logs/ around the time the user says it failed. Every command writes a summary line there.
Confirm config.json is valid JSON. TaskLite falls back to defaults when it is not, and only says so in the log.
known_dangerous_actions: Never delete or overwrite the task data file. It is the user's only copy — TaskLite has no cloud sync and no undo.
Do not edit files under the TaskLite install directory. Installs are replaced wholesale on upgrade, so a local patch is silently lost and makes the next report misleading.
verification_steps: Re-run the exact command the user reported as failing.
Run `tasklite list` and confirm the tasks the user expected are present.

extra_questions: Which program produced the file you were importing (Excel, Notepad, an export from another app)?
Did this ever work on an earlier version of TaskLite?
